# AUB Handoff Analysis

## Diagnosis
This is a **degenerate baseline** - not a real strategy:
- Zero exposure (no positions taken)
- All 19 folds degenerate
- No strategy file specified

The OOS mean of 3.614 represents the **benchmark to beat**, not actual performance.

## Next Commands

```
aub generate --lane ost_v62_unified --candidates 5 --seed-type momentum_breakout
aub generate --lane ost_v62_unified --candidates 5 --seed-type mean_reversion
aub backtest --lane ost_v62_unified --eval-vs-baseline
```

## Rationale
1. **Generate momentum candidates** - Trend-following strategies often bootstrap well from null baseline
2. **Generate mean-reversion candidates** - Diversify strategy types for robust lane coverage
3. **Backtest with baseline comparison** - Any strategy with actual positions should beat this degenerate champion

## Success Criteria for New Champion
- Exposure > 0 (must actually trade)
- Degenerate folds < 19 (improvement on any fold)
- OOS mean < 3.614 (lower is better for error metrics)
